whole, peeled tomatoes, crush them, and
then simmer them in a skillet until they
turn “saucy.”  Add desired seasonings (garlic,
pepper, and salt work well) and a small
amount of olive oil to the cooking mixture.
Top with reduced-fat cheeses.  Pasta is also
excellent served cold when tossed with a
little oil, vinegar, garlic, and fresh herbs. 
Asian Noodles
Noodles have been part of Asian cuisine for
centuries and continue to play a central role
in many well-loved dishes.  They are served
in ways most Westerners are familiar with:
either chilled or hot, covered with a sauce
or dressing, or added to soups or stews.
